eligibility.title: Where you can work from
eligibility.lead: This is what decides which roles can legally hire you. Pemby read what it could from your CV; correct anything that is wrong.

ways.title: How you want to be paid and engaged
ways.lead: A role has to offer one of these for you to hear about it. Pemby starts you on the usual ones for your level.

role.title: The work and the floor
role.lead: What you do, and the least you will take for it. Every field here is optional, and leaving one empty only makes the match looser.

help.citizenships: A second passport can open roles that ask for the right to work somewhere.
help.residenceCountry: The country you are physically in when you work. Every eligibility check runs on it.
help.timezone: Used to work out how many hours you and a team share.
help.minOverlapHours: The fewest hours a day you are willing to share with a team, 0 to 12.
help.hasOwnCompany: An IT Park SRL, a PFA, an LLC — anything you can invoice a company from.
help.permits: A permit you already hold. It is not the same as citizenship, and some roles ask for one.
help.englishLevel: Your own estimate. Pemby never tests it.
help.waysOfWorking: A role has to offer at least one of these.
help.employmentTypes: Leave all three off and Pemby will not filter on this at all.
help.titles: What you call your work. Used to decide which role families you are shown.
help.seniority: Pemby shows roles within one level of this.
help.stack: The technologies you want to keep working with.
help.minRate: Roles that state less than this are not sent. Roles that state nothing are unaffected.
help.dealbreakers: Words that rule a role out for you: on-call, crypto, a specific company.
help.hideNoSalary: Most posts state no salary. Turning this on hides all of them.

empty.residenceCountry: Not set — nothing can match without it
empty.titles: Not set — every role family is shown
empty.seniority: Not set — every level is shown

units.hours: {count, plural, one {# hour a day} other {# hours a day}}

waysHelp.b2b-contractor: You invoice the company from your own company.
waysHelp.eor-employee: The company hires you through an employer of record such as Deel or Remote.
waysHelp.relocation-visa: You move, and the company sponsors the visa.
waysHelp.freelance: Project work, paid per project or per hour.
waysHelp.local: On-site or hybrid work inside the country you live in.
waysHelp.paid-program: Paid internships, mentorships and graduate programs.

counter.announce: {count, plural, =0 {No roles from {country} right now.} one {# role hires from {country}.} other {# roles hire from {country}.}}
counter.likelyMore: {count, plural, one {more looks likely} other {more look likely}}
counter.likelyOnly: {count, plural, one {role looks likely} other {roles look likely}}
counter.likelyNote: The first number is what the posts say outright; it can be zero. The rest only look likely from their wording.
counter.announceLikelyMore: {count, plural, one {# more looks likely.} other {# more look likely.}}
counter.announceLikelyOnly: {count, plural, one {# role looks likely.} other {# roles look likely.}}
counter.noCountryTitle: Add the country you work from
counter.noCountryBody: Every eligibility check runs on it, so there is nothing to count until it is set.
counter.unsupportedBody: Pemby starts with the countries remote roles most often leave out, and {country} isn't one of them yet. Your profile is still yours.

blocked.residenceCountry: Set the country you work from before you continue. Every eligibility check runs on it.

done.title: Your profile is set
done.body: Pemby now knows which roles can legally hire you from where you live, and what you want to do.
done.next: Nothing is delivered yet — sending matches over Telegram, email and web push is still being built. Your profile is saved and you can change any of it whenever you like.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.lead: Everything Pemby matches on. Changes save as you make them, and take effect on the next match.
profile.briefNote: The roles that cleared every check, with the reason each one did.

strength.title: Profile strength
strength.complete: Everything Pemby matches on is answered. Nothing here is holding a match back.
strength.gapsLead: {count, plural, one {One field would sharpen your matches} other {# fields would sharpen your matches}}, best first.

data.title: Export my data
data.body: A JSON file with everything Pemby holds about you, built when you ask for it.
data.includesProfile: Your profile, exactly as the matcher reads it
data.includesParsed: The profile read out of each CV you dropped
data.includesFiles: The details of each CV: name, type, size, when it arrived, how it was read
data.excludes: Not in the file: any link to the stored CV itself. CV files are private and Pemby never hands out a URL to one.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This removes your account and everything attached to it, and signs you out.
delete.bodyAnonymous: You have not signed up yet, so this removes the CV and profile held for this browser. They would be deleted within 24 hours anyway.
delete.removesProfile: Your profile and everything in it
delete.removesFiles: Every CV you dropped, the file and the text read from it
delete.removesAccount: Your account, your sign-in and every session
delete.permanent: It cannot be undone, and Pemby keeps no copy.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again to keep editing.
errors.invalid_display_name: That name is too long. Keep it under 80 characters.
errors.invalid_profile_patch: Pemby couldn't save that value. Try a different one.
errors.invalid_confirmation: The confirmation didn't match. Type it exactly as shown.
errors.delete_failed: Nothing was deleted — something went wrong partway. Try again in a minute.
errors.unavailable: Pemby couldn't save that right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forced_failure: Pemby couldn't save that right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Pemby couldn't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
